answer: Let a new identity start hollow: it may settle only tiny jobs until it collects a public signal of completed work with counterparties drawn from many separate clusters. Those partners must be chosen by a verifiable random draw, not by the recruit, so a clique cannot graduate its own fakes. A gale of thousands of clones then has to buy real service from thousands of unrelated firms; failing or recycling the same partners leaves the identity stuck at the hollow cap, where it cannot swing a vote or drain a market.
